title: Lethality
description: The first Attack each turn deals 50% additional damage.
smart_description: The first Attack each turn deals [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] additional damage.
notes: Stacks as a Counter (tracks applications). Only applies to the first Attack played in the play pile each turn; subsequent Attacks in the same turn receive no bonus. The damage multiplier is multiplicative: (1 + Amount/100).
